failed_conditions.reason: FFmpeg translates the legacy JPEG pixel-format/range encoding and warns about that representation convention. sws_getContext and AVCodecContext.pix_fmt identify the conversion API and its source format; this is not a ROS nominal-message-type mismatch.

loudness.reason: The library emits an explicit diagnostic about the interface value, rather than requiring the user to infer a mismatch from image quality.

detection_stage.reason: The warning is reported while running the camera and decoding frames: run.

resolution.quote: This warning can be safely ignored at present. Long term libjpeg-turbo could be used instead of libav to decode mjpeg frames.
resolution.reason: The accepted patch sets av_log_set_level(AV_LOG_ERROR), suppressing the reported warning rather than changing the format convention. Reports that the suppression works do not identify both unit revisions, so recommended is appropriate.

notes: Accept as warning_only, not demonstrated image corruption or decoder rejection. FFmpeg handles the deprecated format. A separate comment's experimental pixel-format workaround crashes; this does not establish an additional condition in the original composition.
